title: SkillManifest
description: RelayMind registry manifest that sits next to a skill's SKILL.md (spec section 4.2, RM06). Unknown fields are rejected.

version.description: Skill version as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. Change it, or the content hash changes, whenever the skill changes (RM07).

local_eligible.description: false marks the skill external-required (RM04): its final answer comes from an external model, though local preparation may run first (section 9).

resources.description: Package-relative paths the gateway may read for this skill.

completion_predicate.description: ID of a registered gateway validator.

parallel_workflow.description: Optional ID of a registered fixed parallel workflow (RM15). Declaring it joins the workflow; operator configuration must also enable it (section 4.4).
